notes: Launching by a cached path is over. raw.githubusercontent caches by path for 300s and this client was still being served a rev behind even with a changing query string, so the two places Aether re-launches itself - auto-execute on teleport, and the update restart - now resolve the current commit through api.github.com first and then fetch <commit>/main.lua. That path has never been cached, so a re-launch cannot land on the previous build. Both fall back to the old URL if the ref cannot be read.
